facts.fact: Africa Data Centres (Cassava Technologies) built and operates the first hyperscale colocation data centre in Cape Town (south of the city), which already houses global providers, South African enterprises and government; no opening date given, article dated 2023-01-24.
facts.system: Africa Data Centres Cape Town (first facility)

facts.fact: Africa Data Centres operates a flagship modular facility at Midrand, Johannesburg; no opening date given, article dated 2023-01-24.

systems.system: Africa Data Centres Cape Town second facility

note: Second Cape Town facility is under construction (20MW, due mid-2024), so no fact.
